query: For my 82-year-old female patient: among female patients 77–87 undergoing dialysis, what's the IQR of first ICU length of stay (days)?
final_sql: SELECT (percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY length_of_stay) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY length_of_stay)) AS interquartile_range FROM icu_stays;
